description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).
1 layer/1 head, d=64: attention averages prompt digits into a histogram; MLP thresholds cumulative counts vs output index k to emit k-th smallest digit.
Shrunk to d=49, d_ff=20, B=30; same histogram + cumulative-count circuit.
d=49, d_ff=20, constant B=10 (weaker LN-neutralising constant).
d=49, d_ff=20, constant B=4.

d=43, B=4, attention query scale 8 instead of 16.

Ablation: LayerNorm gains left at 1 instead of the nominal std -> signals scaled down ~1/std, thresholds at integers break.
d=43, B=2, q=8: too small a constant; LN scale varies and attention leaks -> 39%.
d=43, B=3, attention query scale 16: smallest constant that still gives 100%.
d=38: position dims only for positions 5..10; prompt positions identified by key = const - sum(pos dims). B=3.
d=38, head output weights 10 -> 1.
